item.title: Gov. Moore recognized for legislation at DC nursing conference
item.description: Gov. Wes Moore received the American Nurses Foundation’s inaugural Health Equity Legacy Award for advancing legislation requiring implicit bias training for certain Maryland health care license renewals.
